name: E2E core 444: updates a prompt
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. The test state is the test's own bookkeeping: take only the values the instructions below name, never mention facts or anything else from it. Write short, plain messages. Your project has a prompt whose handle is prompt_handle. In your first message, write exactly (with the real value of prompt_handle): 'update the prompt "<prompt_handle>" — change the system message to "You are a concise, expert assistant."'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Langy reports successfully updating the prompt.
Langy did not ask for confirmation before updating.
